latest_news.headline: US-Iran deal announced; Hormuz reopening and oil selloff reported
latest_news.text: NBC, PBS, Washington Post, BBC, CNBC and Reuters-linked feeds reported a US-Iran agreement to end the war and restore Strait transit, sending oil lower.

latest_news.headline: Iran uranium tunnels fortified as deal and IAEA role advance
latest_news.text: MSN, Ghana News Agency and other feeds reported fortified uranium tunnels plus IAEA involvement and uranium-dilution terms in the emerging US-Iran arrangement.

latest_news.headline: Israel strikes Hezbollah targets in Beirut after Lebanon drone incidents
latest_news.text: BBC, CNBC, Jerusalem Post, Defense Post and Arab News reported Beirut-area Hezbollah strikes and drones from Lebanon hitting northern Israel.

latest_news.headline: Russia launches major attacks; Ukraine hits Russian oil and industrial facilities
latest_news.text: Reuters reported major Russian attacks injuring nearly three dozen; DW and RFE/RL reported Ukrainian strikes on Russian industrial, oil, and chemical facilities.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan-Afghanistan airstrike and border-clash claims intensify
latest_news.text: Business Standard, DD News and News On AIR reported Pakistani airstrikes killing at least 13 and Afghan claims of 30 Pakistani soldiers killed along the Durand Line.

latest_news.headline: RSF drone strikes hit El Obeid fuel supplies for fifth day
latest_news.text: Sudan Tribune reported RSF drone strikes against El Obeid fuel supplies and army claims of 141 RSF vehicles destroyed across three fronts.

latest_news.headline: Gaza fatalities continue while talks remain open
latest_news.text: AnewZ and other feeds reported Palestinians killed in Gaza as talks continued; several outlets reported Israeli strikes despite ceasefire.

latest_news.headline: DPRK says denuclearisation matter is irreversibly finalised
latest_news.text: Türkiye Today and AnewZ reported North Korea hardening its atomic-status position without a fresh flight-test or device event.

latest_news.headline: China-Taiwan scan shows sea-rescue contacts, not blockade escalation
latest_news.text: SCMP reported a Taiwanese group calling to revive cross-strait sea-rescue drills; no fresh blockade, live-fire surge, or crisis-level PLA mobilization appeared.

latest_news.headline: Oil drops about 4% after Iran deal reporting
latest_news.text: CNBC, BBC, Reuters-linked feeds and OilPrice.com reported oil prices falling as US-Iran deal/Hormuz reopening reporting hit markets.
